events.description: Individual with likely GIA ties arrested transporting 132 lbs of explosives and bomb materials from Canada to the United States.
Planned attacks on tourist sites in Jordan by a UBL cell (disrupted).
Planned multiple attacks on US targets before and on 1 Jan 2000.
CIA briefing to DCI on the millennium threat.
Arrest of an individual with likely GIA ties transporting 132 lbs of explosives and bomb materials from Canada to the US.
Planned attacks by a UBL cell in Jordan on tourist sites on 31 December; the cell was disrupted.
Planned UBL attacks on US targets before and on 1 Jan 2000.
Briefing for the DCI on the Millennium Threat, dated 17 Dec 1999.
MON approved and plan being devised for targeting UBL lieutenants, including pursuit of Abu Zubaida.

key_claims: CIA assessed a strong likelihood that UBL was planning multiple attacks for the New Year timeframe.
A UBL cell in Jordan was disrupted while planning attacks on tourist sites on 31 December.
UBL-linked extremists reportedly planned to bomb US targets in Yemen and Saudi Arabia.
A person with likely GIA ties was arrested 14 December carrying explosives from Canada to the US.
CIA was pursuing Abu Zubaida and developing plans to target UBL lieutenants.
CIA was progressing plans to work with Masood against UBL.
